notes: Line-by-line check. NHS excerpts support: sore throat, hoarse voice and oral thrush as the common local effects; rinsing/brushing after use and a spacer to reduce them; higher long-term doses carry a small risk of systemic steroid effects and can slow growth in children (monitored); effects build over weeks with daily use; a preventer does not relieve a sudden attack; not stopped abruptly after long-term use. No numeric dose added (low/medium/high tiers are described without figures). Formoterol-containing combination inhalers used as both preventer and reliever, CYP3A4 interactions (antifungals, HIV medicines) and adrenal suppression at high doses are standard StatPearls/BNF content.
